name: Quickbase
description_en:
Quickbase is a configurable business application platform for organizing work, data and workflows. Its application model includes role-controlled access, reports, integrations and tools for moving changes through environments.

Evaluating an app requires separating interface design from data authorization and distinguishing the older Sandbox feature from current Solutions-based lifecycle management. Pricing also combines annual per-user starting figures with a platform minimum, so the visible seat price alone does not establish the cost of operating an app.
description_zh:
Quickbase 是可配置的业务应用平台，用于组织工作、数据和流程，应用模型涵盖角色访问、报表、集成及跨环境发布工具。

评估时需区分界面设计与数据授权，也需区分旧 Sandbox 和当前基于 Solutions 的生命周期管理。价格将年付每用户起价与平台最低费用结合，单个席位展示价不足以确定应用运行总成本。

core_features.explanation_en: App, table and field permissions restrict data/actions independently of UI controls.
core_features.explanation_zh: 应用、表和字段权限独立于界面控制限制数据及动作。

core_features.explanation_en: Related apps and pipelines move together within one solution through release environments.
core_features.explanation_zh: 相关应用及流水线在同一个 solution 中跨发布环境一起移动。

core_features.explanation_en: Test-as-role and test-as-user have different write behavior and group caveats.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按角色测试与按用户测试的写入行为不同，也需考虑分组例外。

en: Evaluate a two-role project-tracking app with a denied field.
Review a linked app/pipeline release as one solution.
zh: 评估含两个角色及禁止访问字段的项目追踪应用。
将关联应用／流水线作为一个 solution 检查发布。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Use synthetic records, configure table/field permissions and test them with an unprivileged account.
steps.zh: 使用模拟记录，配置表／字段权限并用低权限账户测试。

steps.en: Map the current Solutions release flow and obtain a quote including platform minimum and add-ons.
steps.zh: 明确当前 Solutions 发布路径，并取得含平台最低费用和附加项的报价。

items.en: UI hiding is not an authorization control.
items.zh: 界面隐藏不属于授权控制。

items.en: Test as role can write to the app and may retain some group privileges.
items.zh: 按角色测试可能写入应用，也可能保留部分分组权限。

pricing.summary_en: A 30-day Business-feature trial is listed. Team starts at $35/user/month and Business at $55 annually priced, excluding platform minimum; Enterprise is custom. Usage-based contracts and add-ons can change the total. A trial is not a sustained-free operating plan.
pricing.summary_zh: 列出含 Business 功能的 30 天试用。Team 年付每用户每月 $35 起，Business $55 起，均不含平台最低费用；Enterprise 定制报价。按用量合同及附加项可能改变总额，试用不是持续免费运行方案。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_zh: 先保护数据再定制屏幕
sections.en: Form rules and hidden tables/reports improve presentation but do not secure underlying records. Set app, table and field permissions, then review alternate URLs and API access. The guide says Quickbase AI follows the user’s permissions, including data hidden only by UI controls.
sections.zh: 表单规则及隐藏表／报表改善显示，不会保护底层记录。应先设置应用、表和字段权限，再检查其他 URL 和 API 访问。指南说明 Quickbase AI 遵循用户权限，包括仅被界面隐藏但仍获授权的数据。

sections.title_en: A test mode may still change data
sections.title_zh: 测试模式仍可能修改数据
sections.en: Test as role uses the app and can apply real changes. Test as user prevents data changes, so it cannot fully exercise every write workflow. Some group-derived privileges can remain during a temporary role change. Use disposable data and a separate account where needed rather than assuming role simulation removes all elevated access.
sections.zh: Test as role 会实际使用应用并可能写入变更；Test as user 阻止数据修改，因此无法完整测试所有写入流程。部分分组权限可能在临时切换角色时保留。应使用可丢弃数据，必要时使用独立账户，不能假定角色模拟会移除全部高权限。

sections.title_zh: 组合相关应用及流水线
sections.en: A solution is the deployment unit for related apps and pipelines, and each can belong to only one solution. Releases move Development to Production, or through Testing on Enterprise. Map dependencies into the intended unit before changing schema that a connected pipeline consumes.
sections.zh: solution 是相关应用及流水线的部署单元，每项只能属于一个 solution。发布从 Development 到 Production，Enterprise 可经过 Testing。修改被关联流水线使用的结构前，应先将依赖纳入合适单元。

sections.title_zh: 生产结构改动可能被覆盖
sections.en: Publishing applies the whole solution to the next environment. The ALM guide warns that manual Production schema edits can be overwritten by the next Development publish and permanently lost if absent from Development. Keep the source of change explicit and separately verify data-backup recovery rather than treating versioning as a universal data restore.
sections.zh: 发布会将整个 solution 更新到下一环境。ALM 指南警告，直接修改 Production 结构可能被下一次 Development 发布覆盖，未记录在 Development 的改动可能永久丢失。应明确变更来源，并单独核对数据备份恢复，不能将版本功能泛化为所有数据恢复。

sections.title_zh: 识别 Sandbox 支持边界
sections.en: The Sandbox guide says new features and technical support stop after June 2026 and directs users to Solutions. Its legacy model supports one sandbox per live app, excludes actions/webhooks/connected tables, and cannot publish copied data back to the live app. Do not base a new lifecycle design solely on an old Sandbox tutorial.
sections.zh: Sandbox 指南说明 2026 年六月后不再提供新功能和技术支持，并引导使用 Solutions。旧模型每个正式应用一个 sandbox，不支持 actions、webhooks 和 connected tables，也不能将复制的数据发布回正式应用。新生命周期设计不应仅依据旧 Sandbox 教程。

sections.title_en: Add platform minimum to the budget
sections.title_zh: 将平台最低费用纳入预算
sections.en: Team starts at $35/user/month and Business at $55, priced annually; the page explicitly excludes the platform minimum from those figures. A usage-based alternative and optional add-ons are also described. Obtain a complete quote for the actual contract model, users and integrations rather than multiplying a seat rate alone.
sections.zh: Team 每用户每月 $35 起，Business $55 起，均为年付计价；页面明确说明这些金额不含平台最低费用。另有按用量选项及可选附加项，应按实际合同模型、用户和集成取得完整报价，不能仅乘以席位单价。
